item.title: Loveland Living Planet Aquarium now the 5th largest aquarium in the nation
item.description: The Loveland Living Planet Aquarium will be the fifth largest aquarium in the U.S. after the opening of its newest building.

item.title: FBI releases first surveillance images of masked person on Nancy Guthrie’s porch
item.description: Authorities investigating the disappearance of Nancy Guthrie more than a week ago released the first surveillance images Tuesday, showing a masked person on her porch the night she went missing.

item.title: ICE chief defends his officers’ actions before Congress after the deaths of 2 protesters
item.description: Todd Lyons, acting director of the U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) defended his officer's actions in Minnesota during a House Committee on Homeland Security oversight hearing of the Department of Homeland Security.

item.title: Annual governors’ gathering with White House unraveling after Trump excludes Democrats
item.description: The National Governors Association annual conference is unraveling after President Donald Trump did not invite some Democrats to events.

item.title: Google, Meta, push back on addiction claims in landmark social media trial
item.description: Jurors in a landmark social media case that seeks to hold companies responsible for harms to children got their first glimpse into what will be a lengthy trial characterized by dueling narratives from the plaintiffs and the two remaining defendants, Meta and YouTube.

item.title: Olympic fans hunt for plushies of mascots Milo and Tina as they fly off shelves
item.description: Tina and Milo, Milano Cortina 2026 mascots, look on during the Olympic Torch Relay on February 05, 2026 in Milan, Italy. Plushies of the two mascots have been hard to find as people buy them up.

item.title: Why mental health crises look different in men and women
item.description: Both may be slow to spot signs of their own mental health crisis. It helps to know what they look like.

item.title: A person has been detained for questioning in the disappearance of Nancy Guthrie, AP sources say
item.description: A person has been detained for questioning in the disappearance of Nancy Guthrie, according to two people familiar with the matter.

item.title: Wasatch County GOP Chair arrested on allegations of child abuse involving water torture
item.description: Officials in Heber City have arrested David Johnson after allegations of aggravated child abuse involving a juvenile.

item.title: Police investigating fatal Tooele crash, significant traffic delays
item.description: Police in Tooele investigated a fatal crash between a vehicle and a pedestrian Tuesday night.
